label_reference: Fresh matched label galleries from experiment 7
within_space_score: Maximum cosine across all reference sources and angles for a wine.
gap: Use unrounded top-1 minus top-2 wine cosine. A gap at least the fixed threshold passes.
gate: If one space passes, use its complete Top-10. If both pass, use the larger gap. A gap tie uses the bottle space.
conflict_control: 8d uses average fusion when both confident spaces choose different wines.
average: Use both complete per-wine score arrays. Average all available scores for each wine. Do not insert zero for an absent reference.
unchanged_merge: Merge both ranked lists. Deduplicate wine_slug. Keep the larger original cosine for a repeated wine. Return the highest 10 unchanged scores.
rrf: Sum 1/(60+rank) from both complete per-wine ranked lists. Deduplicate wine_slug. Return the highest 10 rank scores.
missing_query_label: Return the bottle list. Keep the case in the full denominator.
ties: Sort equal final scores by wine_slug.
timing: Offline accuracy evaluation. Ranking time excludes model inference and segmentation.
interpretation: Raw cosine scores and gaps are trial heuristics. They are not calibrated probabilities. Thresholds and geometry pairs are fixed before fusion scoring. This is the selected failure cohort.
